```python
    def _recover_indented_option(self, name: str, value: str) -> str:
        """Re-read an option value from the raw directive text.

        Docutils consumes the whitespace between an option name and its
        value (the field marker delimiter), so the parsed value of e.g.
        ``:prepend:       </plugin>`` is ``</plugin>``.  For ``:prepend:``
        and ``:append:`` that whitespace is significant -- it indents the
        added line (refs: #10323) -- so recover it from the raw directive
        text: the value is everything after the option name and a single
        separating space.
        """
        for line in self.block_text.splitlines():
            matched = re.match(r'\s+:%s:[ ]?(.*)$' % re.escape(name), line)
            if matched:
                return matched.group(1)
        return value
```
